name: list
title: List
description: A compound stacked-row layout: List is the container, List.Row is the item. Rows take a leading icon or media, a title over an optional subtitle node, and a trailing value (with caption and directional tone) alongside an optional trailing icon. Set separated to space each row onto its own surface, or keep them contiguous with an inset, balanced, edge, or no hairline. Draws no surface itself — wrap it in a Card or place it on the page.
